locKeys.name: Mushroom nursery
locKeys.info: Mushrooms are great! Sometimes things are dangerous, but that's good! Come on! You too can be a bushcrafter from today!

locKeys.name: きのこの苗床
locKeys.info: きのこは良いものです！たまには危険はあるけれど、それがまたいいんです！さぁ、今日からあなたもブッシュクラフターだ！

locKeys.name: pasture
locKeys.info: Fields and grasslands where grass is cultivated as feed for livestock such as cows.

locKeys.name: 牧草地
locKeys.info: 牛などの家畜に与える飼料となる牧草を栽培する畑や草地。もう飼料に悩まされることはない。

locKeys.name: Wheat cropfield
locKeys.info: It is a biennial grass of the grass family that is eaten as a staple food in most countries and is the most produced food crop in the world.

locKeys.name: 小麦畑
locKeys.info: イネ科の越年草で、主食とする国が最も多く、食用作物として世界で最も生産されています。
